claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fast Movement is always-on with no activation cost, no use count, and no reset cadence. The only class-feature family is 'activation', which requires all three of those fields. A 'passive' family (or always_on family) is needed to encode features that are permanently active without any resource gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed effect in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: modify_speed exists as a v4 atom but is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union (which only has GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect). A passive family would still need a modify_speed variant in ClassFeatureEffect to express the +10 ft speed bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: armor_condition predicate (conditional modifier)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bonus is conditional on not wearing Heavy armor. The surface has no mechanism to express a runtime predicate ('while condition X holds') on a passive effect. A conditional gate on passive modifiers — at minimum a closed enum of armor-category predicates — is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while you aren't wearing Heavy armor
